title: Common Frobenius characteristic factor for tame Delsarte monomial deformations with a common cover and injective complement restriction
author: Remke Kloosterman
source_title: Zeta Functions of Monomial Deformations of Delsarte Hypersurfaces
difficulty_reason: The proof must descend invariant rigid-cohomology classes through rational monomial quotient maps that are not everywhere morphisms. It constructs auxiliary weighted covers and uses explicit monomial forms and positivity to extend classes across coordinate divisors, then combines compact-support duality with Frobenius-compatible finite-quotient descent. This arithmetic cohomology argument goes beyond citing that varieties share a cover.

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: Complete selected Theorem2.18 and its essential Sections2.1-2.17 proof core read: explicit monomial rational cover, torus quotient and weighted auxiliary cover, monomial differential forms, Griffiths-Dwork reductions and generic-lift bases, rigid/Monsky-Washnitzer comparison, and Proposition2.15 invariant-form descent across the coordinate divisors. The critical new step uses positivity of k times A to show invariant forms extend to the auxiliary complement, rather than presuming that a rational quotient map is a morphism. Frobenius rationality and finite-quotient compact-support descent are established cited background. The conditional restriction-map injectivity is retained; smooth-cover residue explanation is bundled but not a separately counted weakening or variant. Introductory1.2 prints aA and a-prime A-prime where Definition2.16 and the selected2.18 use inverse matrices; that introductory formulation is not selected. Proposition2.15 uses both quotient and subspace language in its first statement/proof; the selected packet is its explicitly proved Frobenius characteristic-polynomial divisibility conclusion, as stated in2.18, rather than an additional module-direction assertion.

statement_scope: Selected characteristic-polynomial conclusion (last sentence) of Theorem2.18; the additional module quotient-direction assertion is outside the selected scope. Theorem2.18: n>=2 over finite F_q; each coefficient matrix A_i invertible with nonnegative integral entries, a zero in each column and positive A_i^-1(1,...,1)^T. Deformation vectors a_i are nonnegative integral of weighted degree d and a_i A_i^-1 nonnegative; gcd(q,d)=1 for a common integral denominator d, and gcd(q,(n+1)det(A_i))=1 as additionally required by source Remark2.19. Common-cover condition is proportional a_i A_i^-1 (Definition2.16), producing Y_lambda=sum y_j^d+lambda product y_j^b_j and generated deck group G. Assume H^n(V_lambda)->H^n(V_lambda^star) injective. The exact author characteristic polynomial of Frobenius on H^(n-1)(Y_lambda)^G lies in Q[T] and divides each corresponding Xi characteristic polynomial. No unconditional nonsmooth claim or zeta positive-degree consequence is selected.
